motivation: Both adapted and pretrained representation fits retain a large development uncertainty error. Diversify training language and use matched outer-assertion contrasts instead of copying test failures or adding inference keyword rules.
content: Concern and benign content comes exclusively from the existing TRAIN banks. New developer-authored Romanian/Ukrainian frames express subject, time and affirmation, denial, uncertainty or explicit retraction. All four assertion variants share the same body and context within a family. These synthetic labels have not received independent native-language review.
screening: Exclude exact normalized original or actual-memory prefixes found in any recorded DEV, calibration, diagnostic or broad/original regression set; also exclude previous TRAIN duplicates. No evaluation labels or model error IDs enter generation. Preserve exclusions and input hashes.
fitting_plan: Extract both frozen representation views for accepted new TRAIN rows and append to base-reference-18b. Train the four registered base-reference classifiers from scratch for 40 epochs, seed 1020, with equal total weight for old versus new TRAIN and per-field inverse-square-root class balancing. Use the unchanged 6668 eligible DEV rows and selection ordering. Preserve the previous frozen candidates as comparators; no regression fitting.
evaluation: Freeze selected weights before exposed regression replay or fresh neural inference. New representations must preserve the pinned encoder and exact input identities; later final evaluation still requires fresh independent families.
